$comment: Machine-readable feature tracker. WIP=1: only ONE feature may be 'in_progress' at a time. 'passing' means an automated/launch verification actually ran and passed. Features whose ONLY remaining verification needs the user's live machine (Google login, real audio, a physical keypress) are marked 'blocked' with reason 'code complete; awaiting manual acceptance' - the code IS written and builds; see notes/evidence. Statuses: not_started | in_progress | blocked | passing.

features.title: Menubar control surface
features.user_visible_behavior: A menubar (status bar) item appears with no Dock icon and no window; its title reflects the current mode (JZ/PH) and play state. Clicking it opens the now-playing panel, which carries the Toggle / Sign in / Settings / Quit commands (see feature now-playing-panel).
verification: launch smoke: PhonkJazz.app/Contents/MacOS/PhonkJazz runs as .accessory (no Dock icon), process persists; status item built with a click action that presents the now-playing popover
features.evidence: Implemented in Sources/PhonkJazz/{main,AppController}.swift. Verified 2026-08-06 and again 2026-08-11 after the panel change: launches accessory/no-Dock, process alive 3s+, make check green. Visual title render best-confirmed by the user via `make dev`.
features.notes: The plain NSMenu this shipped with was replaced by the now-playing panel on 2026-08-11; statusItem.menu is deliberately left unassigned.

features.title: AppConfig model + persistence
features.user_visible_behavior: Two playlist URLs (jazz, phonk) are held in AppConfig, persisted as JSON under Application Support with the user's playlists as defaults; missing/corrupt config falls back to defaults without crashing.
verification: make test — ConfigTests: playlistURL mapping, URL validation, JSON round-trip, default fallback (4/4 pass)
features.notes: Defaults are the user's supplied jazz/phonk playlist URLs.

features.title: Embed YouTube Music web player with persistent login
features.user_visible_behavior: An off-screen WKWebView loads music.youtube.com using a persistent data store; the user signs into Google in-app once and stays logged in across relaunches.
verification: manual (make dev): sign into Google in the WebView, quit, relaunch — still logged in
features.evidence: Code complete in Sources/PhonkJazz/{PlayerController,PlayerWindowController}.swift (WKWebsiteDataStore.default(), mediaTypes... = []). 'Sign in / Show Player…' surfaces the WebView for login. User acceptance 2026-08-12: signed into Google in-app, audio played from the account, and the session survived a quit + relaunch (no re-auth).

features.title: JS-injected playback control
features.user_visible_behavior: The app loads a playlist URL and starts/pauses playback via evaluateJavaScript; audio actually plays.
verification: manual (make dev): trigger play — audio starts; trigger pause — audio stops
features.evidence: Bug fixed 2026-08-06: was navigating to /playlist?list= (stays paused, no source). Now converts to /watch?list= via YTMURL.watchURL (Core, unit-tested). Verified headlessly in a WKWebView with the app's config: the watch URL auto-plays (video.paused == false) while the playlist URL stays paused. Files: Sources/PhonkJazzCore/YTMURL.swift, Sources/PhonkJazz/{PlayerController,YTMScript}.swift.
features.notes: Selectors centralized in YTMScript.swift, which now reads #movie_player first (see docs/ytmusic-integration.md). User acceptance 2026-08-12: real audio played on the signed-in account, and play/pause stopped and resumed it.

features.title: Toggle playlist by mode
features.user_visible_behavior: Invoking toggle flips jazz<->phonk: loads the other mode's playlist, starts it playing, and updates the menubar to reflect the new mode.
verification: make test — Mode.toggled invariant + config lookup (passing)
manual (make dev): toggling switches the playing playlist and updates the status item
features.evidence: Logic verified: ModeTests + ConfigTests green. Wiring in AppController.toggleMode(). User acceptance 2026-08-12: Ctrl+Opt+Cmd+J from another app switched the playing playlist and updated the status item.

features.title: Global toggle shortcut (Ctrl+Opt+Cmd+J)
features.user_visible_behavior: Pressing Ctrl+Opt+Cmd+J from any app toggles the mode, with no Accessibility permission prompt.
verification: manual (make dev): focus another app, press Ctrl+Opt+Cmd+J, confirm the playlist toggles
features.evidence: Implemented in Sources/PhonkJazz/HotKeyCenter.swift (Carbon RegisterEventHotKey, kVK_ANSI_J + control|option|cmd by default, routed by EventHotKeyID). User acceptance 2026-08-12: pressed from another app, the playlist toggled, and no Accessibility prompt appeared.
features.notes: The binding is now configurable — see feature configurable-shortcuts. Ctrl+Opt+Cmd+J remains the default.

features.title: Settings window to edit playlists
features.user_visible_behavior: Selecting Settings opens a window to edit the jazz and phonk playlist URLs; saving validates them, persists them, and takes effect for the next toggle.
verification: manual (make dev): open Settings, change a URL, save, toggle — new playlist is used; invalid URL is rejected with an alert
features.evidence: Code complete in Sources/PhonkJazz/SettingsWindowController.swift (validates via AppConfig.isValidPlaylistURL, persists via ConfigStore; now also hosts the two shortcut recorders). Partially accepted 2026-08-12: the user opened Settings, rebound a shortcut and saved — so the window, the save path and URL validation of the existing values all ran successfully.
features.notes: Still blocked on the playlist half of its own verification: change a playlist URL, save, and confirm the next toggle uses it, plus confirm an invalid URL raises the alert. Validation logic itself is covered by ConfigTests.testURLValidation.

features.title: Assemble distributable menubar .app bundle
features.user_visible_behavior: `make app` produces a PhonkJazz.app whose Info.plist marks it LSUIElement (menubar-only), launchable by double-click and eligible as a login item.
verification: make app builds PhonkJazz.app; PlistBuddy shows LSUIElement=true; the bundle binary launches as a persistent accessory process
features.evidence: Makefile `app` target. Verified 2026-08-06: bundle built (Contents/{Info.plist,MacOS/PhonkJazz}), LSUIElement=true, launches menubar-only.
features.notes: Unsigned — Gatekeeper may require right-click > Open on first launch, or an ad-hoc/Developer ID signature (follow-up).

features.title: Configurable global shortcuts (play/pause + mode toggle)
features.user_visible_behavior: A second global shortcut (default Ctrl+Opt+Cmd+P) toggles play/pause from any app. Both it and the jazz/phonk toggle are rebindable in Settings by clicking a field and pressing the desired combination; bindings persist and take effect immediately without a relaunch.
verification: make test — Shortcut display/validation + AppConfig decoding an old config.json without shortcut keys (playlists preserved, shortcuts defaulted)
manual (make dev): press Ctrl+Opt+Cmd+P from another app — playback toggles; rebind both shortcuts in Settings, press the new combos, relaunch and confirm they persisted
features.evidence: Core: Sources/PhonkJazzCore/Shortcut.swift (ModifierKeys + Shortcut + key-name table) and AppConfig gains toggleShortcut/playPauseShortcut with additive decoding. App: Sources/PhonkJazz/HotKeyCenter.swift (one Carbon handler, routes on EventHotKeyID, apply() rebinds live, reports refusals), ShortcutRecorderView.swift (click-to-record, intercepts performKeyEquivalent so Cmd-combos are capturable), SettingsWindowController.swift (two recorder rows, collision + URL validation), AppController.applyHotKeys(). Verified 2026-08-11: make check green (lint 0, build clean, 16/16 tests incl. 6 new ShortcutTests); release .app launch smoke. User acceptance 2026-08-12: Ctrl+Opt+Cmd+P toggled playback from another app, Ctrl+Opt+Cmd+J flipped mode, and a rebound shortcut fired on its new combination.
features.notes: Carbon dispatch fixed: one installed handler routes by EventHotKeyID, so a second binding no longer fires both callbacks.

features.title: Now-playing panel on menubar click
features.user_visible_behavior: Clicking the menubar icon opens a panel showing the current track's album art, title, artist and album, a draggable seek bar with elapsed/total time, and previous / play-pause / next controls. It also carries the former menu commands (Toggle, Sign in, Settings, Quit). Info and progress update live while the panel is open.
verification: make test — NowPlaying payload decoding, mm:ss formatting, progress-fraction clamping
headless WKWebView (throwaway probe, shipped script extracted from YTMScript.swift): metadata + duration + seek verified against the live site
panel layout smoke (throwaway, panel source compiled against Core): view loads, no constraint conflicts, labels/slider/transport render for a real and an idle snapshot

manual (make dev): click the icon while a track plays — art/title/artist/album show, the seek bar tracks and scrubs, prev/next change track, play/pause works, and the folded-in commands still function
features.evidence: Core: Sources/PhonkJazzCore/NowPlaying.swift (+7 NowPlayingTests). App: NowPlayingPanelController.swift (NSPopover content: artwork, title/artist/album, seek slider with elapsed/total, prev/play/next, mode button, '…' menu), YTMScript.swift rewritten around shared state helpers, PlayerController next/previous/seek/fetchNowPlaying, AppController owns the popover + 0.5s poll while open. Verified 2026-08-11: make check green (lint 0, build clean, 23/23 tests); live probe returned {"title":"Vois Sur Ton Chemin","artist":"deprezz","duration":187} and seek(30) -> 'api' with currentTime reading back 30; panel smoke PASS (9 subviews, slider 0.1604 == 30/187, idle state disables the bar); release .app launch smoke alive.
features.notes: Found and fixed while verifying: the page's single <video> reports duration NaN / readyState 0 / paused false indefinitely, so the old media-element-only scripts would have shown a frozen 0:00 seek bar and an inverted play state. State now reads #movie_player first (see docs/ytmusic-integration.md). User acceptance 2026-08-12: artwork and track text rendered, the seek bar advanced and scrubbed, and prev/next changed track.
